messages:
Alex W: Quick check — I uploaded the audit-readiness checklist to the drive: https://drive.redwood.internal/audit-readiness-2026. Need owners on the rows under 'Keystore / HSM integration' and 'Audit log ingestion'. Can folks claim tasks by EOD Friday? cc @Jordan P @Maria L
Jordan P: I can take the Keystore/HSM integration verification. Do we already have the vendor attestation artifacts?
SecurityBot: Artifact upload complete — s3://redwood-audit/attestations/vendor-hsm-2026-03-12.zip :package:
Jordan P: Got it. I'll validate cert chain + KMS policy. Ping if you need key rotation proof or the attestation hash.
Samir: I'll own audit log ingestion checks. Quick question — do auditors want prod samples only, or prod + non-prod?
Maria L: For SOC2 fieldwork they typically want a prod sample and one non-prod where feasible. I'll loop in infra to produce a sanitized sample.
Devon: Infra can provide a non-prod sample. @Samir — can you list the exact queries or artifacts you need? e.g., `SELECT * FROM audit_events WHERE ts > '2026-01-01' LIMIT 10;`
Samir: Yes — need that sample query, retention policy doc, and the logshipper config snippet used in prod. @Devon can you attach the `logstash.yml` extract?
Devon: ```yaml
filebeat.inputs:
  - type: log
    paths: /var/log/redwood/*.log
output.elasticsearch:
  hosts: ["es.internal:9200"]
```
Alex W: Thanks. One snag: the checklist still shows 'TBD' for the rotation playbook owner. @Jordan P can you confirm who will write that? Also, is there an open PR for the auditflow validation we should attach to the evidence?
Jordan P: I'll take rotation playbook authoring. PR #482 contains the validation tests — it needs one review from eng-ml. @Maria L can you ping them for a reviewer?
Maria L: :thumbsup: will ping eng-ml and ask for a reviewer by EOD. Also compliance asked for the KMS key metadata export (JSON) — I can export and scrub PII before attaching.
Alex W: Action items recap: Jordan -> HSM attestation validation + rotation playbook; Samir -> audit log ingestion checks + sample queries; Devon -> attach logshipper snippet + non-prod sample; Maria -> ping eng-ml + scrubbed key metadata export. I'll update the checklist and set tentative due date. Blockers?
Jordan P: :eyes: none on my side, timeline looks ok.
Samir: I might need a short-lived access grant to read the prod bucket for the sample. @Alex W can you file the access request?
Alex W: On it — filed AR-1092 (access-requests). Please add who exactly needs access in the comments.
Maria L: Added @Samir. Also small compliance ask: auditors want a short paragraph describing fallback routing for keys — please include a brief section in the playbook about fallback + failover policy.
Jordan P: Will include a short section (3-4 lines) on fallback logic and HSM failover and paste it here for quick review.
Jordan P: "Fallback: if primary HSM fails, KMS falls back to cached keys with a TTL of 1h and routes requests to the secondary HSM cluster in eu-west-1. Ops receives high-priority alerts on failover and automated reroute is logged for audit."
Alex W: Perfect. I'll mark owners in the checklist as assigned and move due date to next Thursday. Thanks team :v:
